gates.G1_deployment: KILL_UNDER_CURRENT_ENVELOPE: no live execution or venue/account friction validation. The user separately authorizes this cheap, reversible offline research screen.

gates.mechanism: Delayed attention/flows might cause similar pre-rally price and volume states to precede further buying. Buyers of later inventory would pay; this is a hypothesis, with systematic and retail competition and no demonstrated proprietary advantage.
gates.half_life: UNKNOWN; evaluate only 7-day outcomes with a full 24-hour information delay.
gates.data_fidelity: Daily OHLCV can study slow selection but does not measure intraday fills, book depth, outages, queue, historical fee tiers or capacity.
gates.live_data: Public spot klines endpoint; parity, historical archive revisions and actual known_at require prospective validation.
gates.research_budget: One fixed model, one target, one horizon, no outcome-driven retuning. At most 240 randomly-like sampled altcoin symbols plus BTC benchmark; public data only. Register failures, pivots and coverage. Stop after this screen; next independent protocol required for refinements.

data.symbol_catalog: All paginated S3 archive prefixes under data/spot/monthly/klines/, including inactive symbols. Do not use current exchangeInfo to construct historical eligibility.
data.universe: USDT quote; exclude BTC (reference), leveraged suffixes UP/DOWN/BULL/BEAR, and the fixed base exclusion list. Sort remaining symbols by SHA256(screen_id + ':' + symbol), take first 240. No outcome or present market-cap selection. Sampling is conditional on the current public archive retaining the symbol; completeness is not guaranteed.
data.source_priority: Public REST klines for selected symbols, paginated to cutoff. Archive monthly 1d ZIP fallback for empty/error symbols. Preserve missing intervals rather than forward-fill. Save all raw responses, retrieval UTC, URL, hash and coverage failures.
data.archive_unit: Normalize millisecond and microsecond open/close timestamps using magnitude; archive spot switched to microseconds in 2025.
data.bitemporal: event_time is exchange candle time. Actual known_at is retrieval UTC in this run. Historical availability at close + 24h is an explicit simulation assumption, never a claim that this machine observed it then. No future candle fields.

schedule.decision: Mondays 00:00 UTC, plus current Monday 2026-09-07 snapshot.
schedule.features_end: Saturday candle close, i.e. Sunday 00:00 UTC minus timestamp precision; Monday execution imposes 24h+ delay.
schedule.train: Entries in 2021-01-01 through 2023-12-31, whose whole 7-day outcomes finish before 2024-01-01.
schedule.evaluation_1: 2024 entries with complete 7-day calendar window before 2025-01-01. No tuning from this segment.
schedule.evaluation_2: 2025-01-01 onward, complete 7-day calendar windows before cutoff. Fixed training set and scaler; no refit on evaluation data.
schedule.purge: No training outcome may extend into evaluation. Omit cross-year boundary weeks from the earlier segment. Weekly outcomes do not overlap within a symbol. Cross-asset observations from the same week are dependent.

eligibility.past_only: 90 consecutive complete positive-price, positive-volume daily bars ending at the features_end day. Median prior 30-day quote volume >= 5,000,000 USDT. Eligibility is recomputed for every decision date using only these past bars.
eligibility.survival: Do not require any future bar or current TRADING status. Missing entry/exit/intervening outcome bars receive -100% return in the conservative primary screen, are counted explicitly and cause data-fidelity caution. This is a stress assumption, not a measured delisting recovery. Show a separate missing-entry-cash sensitivity if triggered; never drop failed holdings.
eligibility.identity: Symbols are treated separately, no retrospective stitching of migrations or renames. Archive retention and symbol reuse remain limitations.

features: log close return 7d minus BTC log return 7d
log close return 30d minus BTC log return 30d
log(mean quote volume last 7d / mean quote volume preceding 23d)
standard deviation of daily log returns over 30d, population ddof=0

model.scaling: Training-only median and IQR for each feature; zero IQR replaced by 1; clip scaled values to [-5,5].
model.target: 1 if next 7-day open-to-close gross return >= 20% AND exceeds contemporaneous BTC return by >= 10 percentage points; 0 otherwise. All eligible non-rallies, negative returns and missing-outcome failures enter as controls.
model.score: Fraction of positive labels among the 200 nearest training observations. Uncalibrated analog frequency, not a guaranteed or calibrated forward probability. No training evaluation score is evidence.
model.ranking: Descending score, then symbol lexicographically. No expected-return, threshold or parameter search.

portfolio.selection: Top 5 eligible symbols, equal initial weights, long spot only, 7-day holds. Full weekly close/reopen for every method, including retained names. If fewer than 10 eligible symbols, all methods sit in zero-yield USDT cash that week.
portfolio.price_proxy: Monday daily open to Sunday daily close; these are accounting reference prices, not observed executable fills. One full-day feature delay. No leverage, intraday stops, high-price exits or perfect timing.
portfolio.cost_identity: net factor per holding = (1 + gross_return) * (1 - side_cost) / (1 + side_cost); initial fee reduces quantity and exit fee reduces proceeds. Missing-price total loss remains -100%.
controls: BTC with the same weekly round trips
portfolio.currency: STRATEGY_PNL_CURRENCY=USDT; treat USDT/USD parity only as an assumption. Selection comparisons are in USDT. REPORTING_CURRENCY=BRL for conditional capital-value illustration with explicitly flat FX=5.1253 from the prior dated screen. FX gains are not alpha; operator benchmark, tax, conversion route, risk premium and execution costs remain UNKNOWN.
portfolio.economic_reference: US$5000 fully paid spot, no separate margin, C/N=1 while invested. Existing same-day conditional BRL benchmark R$2900.34/year on R$25626.50 (11.3177%) before risk premium and actual attention/FX costs; illustrative attention adds R$1200/year. This current constant-rate reference is not a synchronized historical benchmark or a future expected return. Measured friction absent => MIN_GROSS_EDGE_WORTH_PURSUING UNKNOWN.

evaluation.primary: Mean paired weekly log wealth-factor difference: analog portfolio minus equal-weight eligible basket in evaluation_2, after base costs.
evaluation.uncertainty: Circular 4-week block bootstrap, 5000 repetitions, seed 20260907, 95% percentile CI. Same weeks resampled for both methods; never count coins as independent trials. Conditional on this fixed discovery model, not full search-history-adjusted Proof.
secondary: target hit rate lift relative to eligible basket
annualized geometric return using actual weeks
current complete rank with nearest winner and non-winner examples
evaluation.power_before_outcomes: At most about 52 and 87 evaluation weeks. Conservative effective n=floor(n_weeks/4). A normal-design 80%-power, two-sided-5% MDE is (1.96+0.842)/sqrt(effective_n) weekly paired standard deviations: approximately 0.777 SD for 52 weeks and 0.611 SD for 87 weeks. Report exact count and observed-scale descriptive MDE; this design cannot refute small effects. No DSR will be computed from one model or incompatible legacy Sharpe trials.
evaluation.decision: PROMISING only if primary 95% CI lower bound >0, mean differences versus equal basket and momentum are positive in both segments, evaluation_2 target lift >1, and evaluation_2 advantage over basket remains positive at 50bps/side. Otherwise REJECT_FOR_THIS_SPECIFICATION if evaluation_2 primary point estimate <=0; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Fewer than 40 evaluated weeks in either segment or fewer than 100 training positives => UNDERPOWERED. Material acquisition/identity failures may override to INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_FIDELITY. No verdict confirms alpha, deployment or universal no-edge.
evaluation.after_failure: Save research-only current ranking with explicit negative/inconclusive verdict; do not present it as buy recommendations, do not retune, and do not automatically activate monitoring.

required_controls: future-price perturbation leaves past features/selection unchanged
